menu._note: true = show the one-line descriptions in the menu: under each service (navSub) and on the Featured industry (indQ) and Start here (navSub.audit) cards; texts live in _site.json

workSat._note: optional per-image saturation for the project cards (default .15, set in site.css); add "file.jpg": value to override one image

currency.note: US dollars are the base. Update these two rates every 3 months (or when a rate moves more than 5%). Converted prices are rounded down: prices to the hundred, hourly rates to the nearest 5.
